description: Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma unveils AI anchor 'Ankita' to share cabinet updates. This step marks Assam's move towards tech-driven governance and improved public outreach
body_lead: Assam CM unveils AI anchor 'Ankita' to deliver cabinet updates Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma unveils AI anchor 'Ankita' to share cabinet updates. This step marks Assam's move towards tech-driven governance and improved public outreach Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma introduced the state's first artificial intelligence news anchor named "Ankita" on Wednesday. The digital initiative aims to modernise government communications while enhancing citizen engagement.
